title: MusicDrop v1.5.3 Available
changelog:
• Glassmorphic Translucency & Opacity Slider: Adjust transparency of all sections, category cards (playlists, albums, folders, artists, trending mixes) from 10% to 100% with live percentage readout and quick presets
• Clean Edge-to-Edge Transparent Display: Removed the top accent gradient band for a clean, seamless, transparent header and status bar experience
• Typography & Font Style Chooser: Select Default Sans, Modern Sans, Rounded, Serif Elegant, or Monospace fonts
• High-Contrast Font Colors: Choose Adaptive, Pure White, Warm Cream, Vivid Gold, Cyan Ice, or High Contrast text for crystal-clear readability
• Settings Page Redesign: Beautiful commercial music app layout with Appearance Hero, Hardware Audio Equalizer, Seamless DJ Crossfade, and Instant Updater
• Wallpaper Skin Integration: Apply custom gallery wallpapers or preset skins with adaptive glass overlay
